facts.fact: Simone 播报 Angelfish Inlet 夏令营主题活动，Visitor's Center 领徽章即可全日通行。
facts.anchor: From now until late tonight, our staff is hosting a summer-camp themed event at Angelfish Inlet.

facts.fact: 活动含皮划艇下 Palmera Canal（贯穿孩子区与成人区之间的运河）、绳索课程与射箭场（神秘大奖）。
facts.anchor: paddle down the Palmera Canal, which runs between Thrill Harbor and Tranquil Cove

facts.fact: 日落后可在火坑边讲鬼故事、烤美食热狗、用手工棉花糖做 s'mores。
facts.anchor: you can tell ghost stories with your friends around a firepit and roast gourmet hot dogs or make killer s’mores with handmade marshmallows

facts.fact: 晚九点半 Iguana Beach 有烟花大秀，多舞台现场音乐与各式餐车。
facts.anchor: The breathtaking show starts at nine-thirty p.m. at Iguana Beach.

facts.fact: 热指数将在下午两至三点达峰，广播提醒补水并使用降温站。
facts.anchor: the heat index is on the rise and will peak between two and three p.m.
